Pull request: #381 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Branch `bb/relay-241-generic-rest-06-09-expose-item-create-thr_6a73b87nyr` has been pushed to origin. ## Summary Implements issue #241: `POST /api/databases/:id/items`, `GET /api/items/:id` (with optional `?include=path` breadcrumb assembly), and `PATCH /api/items/:id` with `ifVersion`-checked optimistic concurrency. - All three routes are thin mappings onto the existing choke-point (`itemsHandler.ts`); the idempotent-create replay, `computed_readonly`/`version_conflict`/`database_archived` rejections, and the breadcrumb walk itself live entirely in `@semprec/data`'s choke-point, not the handler. - Added two new choke-point methods, `findItem` and `getItemPath`, since `GET`/`PATCH /api/items/:id` carry no `databaseId` in the URL to route the existing partition-scoped lookups through. - Wired into `app.ts`'s dispatcher, `routeMatrix.ts`'s route inventory (issue #143), and `chokePointWriteBoundary.unit.test.ts`'s handler mapping (issue #154). - New test suite `itemsHandler.test.ts` covers every acceptance criterion: idempotent create replay (no second insert), missing `Idempotency-Key` → `validation_failed`, archived-database rejection on create/patch, full breadcrumb assembly across nested inline databases, single-entry path for top-level items, merge-by-key patch, 409 `version_conflict` with `details.currentItem`, 403 `computed_readonly` on a rollup-typed write, and unauthenticated 401s. - Verified: `backend/`'s full `pnpm run verify` (1015 integration/unit tests + 5 e2e tests, all passing) and `web/`'s full `pnpm run verify` (139 tests passing, no regressions — this issue is backend-only). Relay-Step-Status: pass
- 2026-09-11 17:29Z — Relay BB run pushed an update. Pull request: #381 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Pushed the review-fix commit to branch `bb/relay-241-generic-rest-06-09-expose-item-create-thr_6a73b87nyr`. ## Summary Addressed all 4 open review findings on PR #381: 1. **DoS / unbounded-traversal risk** — `chokePoint.ts`'s `getItemPath` now tracks visited database ids and stops the moment one repeats, so a `parent_item_id` cycle can no longer hang the request forever. 2. **Race between two separate transactions** — `GET /api/items/:id?include=path` now derives the item from `getItemPath`'s own chain instead of a separate `findItem` call, closing the window where the item could change between two reads. 3. **Misleading validation message** — `PATCH /api/items/:id` now reports `"'properties' is required"` when the field is absent, instead of reusing the wrong-type message. Added regression tests: `getItemPath` cycle-safety (via direct-SQL corruption of `parent_item_id`, since that state is unreachable through the public API) and normal-chain assembly in `chokePoint.test.ts`, plus handler-level coverage for 404-with-`?include=path` and the corrected PATCH error message. Full `backend/` `pnpm run verify` passed (204 unit + 1019 integration + 5 e2e tests) and `web/` `pnpm run verify` passed (139 tests, no regressions). Relay-Step-Status: pass
- 2026-09-11 17:57Z — Relay BB run pushed an update. Pull request: #381 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Pushed the review round-2 fix commit to branch `bb/relay-241-generic-rest-06-09-expose-item-create-thr_6a73b87nyr`. ## Summary Addressed all four findings from PR #381's second review round (3 medium, 1 low): 1. **Missing `findItem` unit tests** — added a `describe("findItem", ...)` block to `chokePoint.test.ts` covering the existing-item and unknown-id cases directly at the choke-point level. 2. **Missing invariant assertion in the cycle test** — added `expect(path.at(-1)?.id).toBe(rootItem.id)`, since the GET handler derives the found item exclusively from that chain position. 3. **Missing ADR for the iterative traversal pattern** — added `docs/adr/2026-09-11-iterative-parent-chain-traversal-in-choke-point.md`, recording why `getItemPath` walks `parent_item_id` one level at a time with a visited-set cycle guard rather than a single recursive CTE. 4. **Dead code in the PATCH handler** — folded the two-step required/type check into a single `requireJsonObjectField` helper, removing the now-unreachable `?? {}` fallback. Full `backend/` `pnpm run verify` (204 unit + 1021 integration + 5 e2e tests) and `web/` `pnpm run verify` (139 tests) both passed with exit code 0. Relay-Step-Status: pass
